title: About Capstone Vietnam
summary: A higher education consultancy founded in 2009, with offices in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.
bodyHtml:
Capstone Vietnam is a higher education and private sector consultancy. Our first clients, in March 2010, were The University of Chicago and Hobsons.

What we do

We advise Vietnamese students and families on studying abroad, and we help schools, colleges and universities from around the world recruit in Vietnam.
